violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: boxed raw bacon underneath a container of produce in the one-door cooler on the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC: PIC RE-ARRANGED THE FOODS. TALL OAKS AT RESTON (Inspection Date: 10/09/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) cooked rice (129 F), cooked chicken (122 F), pureed rice (119 F), and pureed beef (119 F) on the expo line for 1.5 hour. 2) unsalted melted butter (83 F) on a table at the cook line for 1-hour. 3) cooked rice (120 F) on the stove for 1.5 hrs.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: 1) The foods were put in the steamer to reheat. Rice was temped at 195 F when reheated. 2) PIC moved unsalted butter to the stove to reheat. 3) PIC discarded the rice.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: yogurt (58 F) sitting in melted ice at a nurse station for more than 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: THE YOGURT WAS DISCARDED.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: bulk containers of dry goods.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: PIC LABELED THE BULK CONTAINERS DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed fruit flies in the drink station area, mop sink room, and on potatoes in the prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC REMOVED THE POTATOES. ENSURE PEST SERVICE IS CONDUCTED BY THE FOLLOW UP DATE OF OCTOBER 18TH, 2026.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: prep table in the back prep area. A stainless steel container was being used to level the table.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. ENSURE THE PREP TABLE IS REPAIRED OR REPLACED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed holes in the ceiling tile and cracked floor tiles in the mop sink room and holes in the walls throughout the kitchen not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. ENSURE PHYSICAL FACILITY IS IN GOOD REPAIR BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors underneath the equipment are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. ENSURE FLOORS ARE CLEANED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed utensils and food storage containers being run through the high temperature dish machine. Using PIC’s high temperature dish plate, hot water rinse of the dish machine was observed at 153f
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC RAN THE DISH MACHINE FOR TWO MORE CYCLES. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE WAS OBSERVED AT 163f. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO TRAIN DISHWASHING STAFF TO RUN THE EMPTY DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT REACHES 160f. AFTER IT REACHES 160f, DISHES CAN BE WASHED AND SANITIZED IN THE DISH MACHINE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over FOOD PREP and CLEAN DISH areas where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. EHS discussed with PiC to have traps moved, PIC called pest company during the visit.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BACK DOOR TO TRASH AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PIC notified maintenance to repair doors.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level is not observed at the Spray hose at pre-scrape before the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. EHS instructed manager to replace the spring on the hose or shorten the hose so it is above the flood rim of the pre scape basin. PIC notified maintenance for repairs.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) puréed green beans was observed at 130f; 2) puréed chicken was observed at 120f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE FOOD TO 165f IN THE STEAMER. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PLACE ALL PREPARED PURÉED MEALS IN THE HOT BOX TO PROPERLY HOT HOLD.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw beef kabobs being stored over whole, uncut produce in the walk-in cooler in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC STACKED THE RAW BEEF ON TOP OF A BOX OF RAW CHICKEN.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Meat slicer was observed being stored under a black bag indicating “not in-use”. Underneath the cover, food debris was observed stuck on the surface of the meat slicer and on the table directly under the meat slicer.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC BEGAN CLEANING MEAT SLICER. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CLEAN MEAT SLICER.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: Observed prepared plates of puréed meals sitting on the expo line. Puréed beans were observed at 46f, and puréed chicken was observed at 49f. Upon discussion with PIC, staff portioned out the food for dinner service between 30 minutes and 1 hour prior. Meals were intended to remain there until dinner time, 2-3 hours later.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO MOVE ALL THE PREPARED MEALS TO A REFRIGERATOR TO COOL AND COLD HOLD. MEALS MAY BE PREPARED IN ADVANCE BUT CANNOT BE LEFT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE FOR SEVERAL HOURS. TALL OAKS AT RESTON (Inspection Date: 07/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved backflow prevention device on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC A PICTURE OF THE APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE FOR THE MOP SINK. PLEASE INSTALL ON MOP SINK.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The ceiling tiles around the cook line and the back of the cook line were observed discolored and stained.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO HAVE MAINTENANCE CLEAN THE CEILING TILES.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: meat slicer
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CLEAN AND SANITIZER THE MEAT SLICER. STAFF BEGAN CLEANING THE MEAT SLICER.
